import rates
from donations import Donation, load_donations, ROWS
from tracker import DonationTracker

KEY = sorted(rates._RATES)[0]


def test_peak_after_record():
    t = DonationTracker()
    t.record(Donation(KEY, 2))
    assert t.peak() == 2 * rates._RATES[KEY]
    t.record(Donation(KEY, 9))
    assert t.peak() == 9 * rates._RATES[KEY]


def test_peak_of_stored():
    t = DonationTracker()
    best = 0
    for x in load_donations():
        t.record(x)
        best = max(best, x.pounds * rates._RATES[x.donor])
        assert t.peak() == best


def test_no_new_lookups_when_unchanged():
    t = DonationTracker()
    for x in load_donations():
        t.record(x)
    t.peak()
    before = rates.LOOKUPS
    t.peak()
    t.peak()
    assert rates.LOOKUPS == before


def test_nothing_recorded():
    assert DonationTracker().peak() == 0
